common.heroTitle: Guild Wars 2 tools for players who want to know exactly.
common.heroText: breakbar.cc is a collection of tools built around Guild Wars 2 — the stuff that actually helps you with your next goal. All tools are build and maintained by dedicated GW2 players and we'd love to hear your feedback
common.footerLeft: Not an official Guild Wars 2 offering. Fan project, built out of personal need.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.intro: This privacy policy applies to breakbar.cc. The tools on the individual subdomains (e.g. fractal.breakbar.cc, legendary.breakbar.cc, voidlog.breakbar.cc) have their own, separate privacy policies.
datenschutz.responsibleText: The person named in the legal notice is the data controller for processing on this website under the GDPR.
datenschutz.hostingText: This website is hosted by the following provider, which automatically processes technically necessary server log data (including IP address, date and time of access, page requested, browser used):
datenschutz.cookiesText: This website does not use any tracking or analytics cookies. Only the language setting (German/English) is stored technically in the browser.
datenschutz.analyticsText: This website uses Vercel Web Analytics to analyze page views. The service is cookieless and does not store any personally identifiable or cross-device identifiers; it only collects anonymized, aggregated statistics (e.g. number of page views, page URL, referrer, coarse device/browser category). Data is not combined with other data sources, and no user profiles are created. Provider: Vercel Inc., 340 S Lemon Ave #4133, Walnut, CA 91789, USA. More information: https://vercel.com/docs/analytics/privacy-policy
datenschutz.rightsText: You have the right at any time to access, rectify, erase, and restrict the processing of your personal data, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For questions, please contact the address listed in the legal notice.
